risk_note: RV2 (funds). adminBatchApproveWithdrawals and adminRejectWithdrawal are implemented through withdrawalCommands (BR-WDR-10, BR-WDR-05, BR-WDR-17; D10-595). With the automatic switch off every withdrawal waits for a person, and there was no way to review one. Approve: each id on its own transaction with its own result, under plain idempotency; a refusal is that id's result and never fails the others. Reject: W3 with the WITHDRAW:RETURN voucher, event and audit in one transaction. The manual W3 gains a guard it never had, in the domain command: hold_reason=payer_side_after_transfer means the channel reported a failure but may have paid, so with the switch on the latest query must be fail; no query, pending or unknown refuses, success refuses (W11 ends it). Rejecting anyway would pay twice. 「订单不存在」 is recorded as unknown with no verified code, so it refuses until one is registered; payer_side_codes is empty until verified, so this state does not occur before then. systemRejectNegative does not take this guard. switchOn moved from withdrawal-proven-success.ts to withdrawal-commands.ts as provenSuccessSwitchOn, for one reading of the switch; PROVEN_SUCCESS_SWITCH stays exported from the old place. No migration: couli_app already has the column grants. Known and not changed: went-negative.ts writes no audit record for the system W3 (FU-WENT-NEGATIVE-AUDIT). The console has no buttons yet (fe).

reviews.note: Independent Claude via claude-run.sh under approvals 36, Codex not logged in (401). couli-runs/B2-09k/money-review-r1.json, static, nothing executed. Two S2 fixed after it, no second round: reviewed_at in the answer now comes from the stored row, and the idempotency path encodes the id so a hand-crafted id reaches the 20001. The implementation otherwise did not change.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude each round, static, not run by the reviewer. r1 fail with 4 S1 and 1 S2, all tests that could not catch a wrong implementation: the balance read under the lock, W3 past W2's guards, review_mode auto, every transfer attempt, a route rejection of a frozen member. A new independent Claude added #55 to #62 in a new file, no existing assertion changed. r1's literal two transfer attempts cannot exist: the unique index payout_attempts_transfer_once_key allows one per withdrawal (D10-237), so the tests use a transfer attempt plus a later failed query. r2 on the increment pass, with one S2 accepted: no test sends a percent-encoded ? in the id, reachable only by a hand-crafted path. After r2 one more test(spec) commit changes only types (the fixture's suite, so the root tsc -b passes); no assertion changed and it was not reviewed.
